setting.name: Disable Superfetch (SysMain)
setting.casual_explanation: This runs the current app command that stops the SysMain service if it is running.
setting.why_people_change_it: People use it when they want to test the current app's SysMain stop action without changing the longer-term research-backed service records.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: The command is explicit and the app can start the service again during rollback, but this card still lives only in the first-party provider and is not a validated research-provider preset.
setting.professional_notes: The current app still exposes this tweak through app/Services/TweakProviders/PerformanceTweakProvider.cs and engine/Tweaks/Commands/Performance/DisableSuperfetchTweak.cs. The current engine tweak detects with sc query SysMain, applies sc stop SysMain, and uses sc start SysMain for rollback when the previous state was running. This record keeps the live behavior documented without publishing it as a validated research-provider card yet.
